name: Collapsing Roof Trap (CR 2)
body:
Collapsing Roof Trap
CR 2

XP 600

Type mechanical; Perception DC 20; Disable Device DC 16

EFFECTS

Trigger manual (see below); Reset manual

Effect The collapse itself causes no actual damage. On a successful Reflex save (DC 15) characters in the bury zone are assumed to have created a clear pocket around themselves when the roof collapses and may begin to dig themselves out. multiple targets (all targets in a 10-ft.-square area)

Trigger A manual trigger pulls a rope attached to ceiling supports and knocks them down in the affected area, causing the roof to collapse.
